subject: gk
question: As per the National Infrastructure Pipeline 2019-25, what is the share of energy sector projects out of the total estimated capital expenditure of Rs. 111 lakh crore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the** National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP**) 2019-25, the energy sector projects account for** approximately 24%** of the total estimated capital expenditure of Rs. 111 lakh crore. 
 
• The NIP **outlines that major sectors like energy, roads, urban development, and railways constitute** a significant portion of the projected infrastructure investments
 
• The NIP is an **ambitious plan aimed at creating world-class infrastructures **across India.
 
• This will enhance the **overall quality of life for its citizens. **
 
• The NIP will also boost project preparations and attract both domestic and foreign direct investments into the Indian economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NIP aims to capture key greenfield and brownfield projects for investments across all economic and social infrastructure sub-sectors on a best-effort basis
 
• NIP is a collection of projects and programs totalling INR 102 lakh crore in infrastructure development over the next five years. 
 
• It follows the government's goal of making India a $5 trillion economy by 2024-25. 
 
• NIP covers economic and social infrastructure projects in sectors such as Roads (19%), Urban (16%), and Railways (13%) that account for almost 70% of India's expected infrastructure capital spending.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71cf67904c804c465e50b50beae0b7e84ec5728fb68cc6d213258c5ad0f3ecb4.png]
